title: Readiness and exit
description: READY-01 to READY-10 gate entry. EXIT-01 to EXIT-03 close UAT. Not checked is not a pass. Build, URL, accounts, mocks and acceptance authority are checked here, not in Gates. Execution data intake is READY-05.

checks.Check: Every S1/S2 story and the two additions remain visible, with one owner and scenario mapping; current delivery mapping attached without silent exclusions.
checks.Evidence needed: Original 49-case definition coverage plus the 76-case execution reconciliation and all 56 Howard/Chan source mappings; retained rule/detail follow-ups and Sprint 1/2 delivery mapping remain visible. A destination mapping does not prove every variant covered.

checks.Check: Each person completes their assigned business scripts and a different QA reviews them.
checks.Evidence needed: Review record names author, reviewer, scenario IDs, version, issues and disposition. Josh/Gavin pair; Kent/Chan pair; Howard/Gavin pair. Gavin reviews Josh and Howard; Howard reviews Gavin. Current counts: Josh 18, Kent 13, Chan 15, Howard 25, Gavin 5. Gavin reviews 43 Josh/Howard cases; record actual sign-off, do not infer it.

checks.Check: Business expected results are approved or affected scenarios clearly blocked; no feature is removed to resolve a rule conflict.
checks.Evidence needed: Gate resolution with approver/date/source and affected script revision. Blank or Open is not approved.

checks.Check: Named integrated build and external/mock identities are available.
checks.Evidence needed: Build/commit, QA URL, deployed components, dependency/mock versions and smoke results tied to current build.

checks.Check: Execution data is received and mapped to the DATA IDs, and reset, date and fault controls work.
checks.Evidence needed: Dev fixture source and version where supplied; business owner and revision for QA-owned sets; mapping to each DATA ID; user mapping without credentials; setup read-back; before/after reset receipt; owned data isolation; control rehearsal. Before Wednesday verify budget copies 100/1000/1040, source-specific school/parent controls and named shared-clock windows.

checks.Check: Critical end-to-end journeys have a rehearsal record or exact blocker on the candidate build.
checks.Evidence needed: FAS online and paper, subsidy/charge/payment, lifecycle/top-up/history, View As and FAQ results with build/actor/date/evidence. No old diagnostic pass reuse.

checks.Check: Financial, permission and prior blocking-defect regressions are checked before UAT entry.
checks.Evidence needed: Current-build ledger/charge/payment reconciliation, family/school isolation, View As write prevention and targeted retest evidence. R1-DRAFT-04 concurrent duplicate-credit check runs in the API regression suite, with its run linked here. Unresolved material failures block affected acceptance.

checks.Check: Business session roles and acceptance authority are named.
checks.Evidence needed: Business participants, authorized acceptance decision-maker/delegate, QA facilitator and recorder; acceptance authority is not inferred from QA attendance.

checks.Check: Execution copy and evidence/result conventions are ready.
checks.Evidence needed: Record build/date/actor, actual result, evidence, defects and limitations per case. Use Pass/Fail/Blocked/Not Run; In Progress is temporary. Record every required variant: confirmed failure makes the case Fail; otherwise an unresolved required variant makes it Blocked. Time not available means Not Run and incomplete execution, not Blocked. Definition pack Passed/Failed maps to Pass/Fail. No partial case is Pass.

checks.Check: Preparation completion is reported honestly, without claiming execution or sign-off.
checks.Evidence needed: Reviewed pack, data/setup requirements, open-rule register and rehearsal/readiness report. Unready items listed with exact dependency/owner; future UAT results and business decision remain separate.

checks.Check: All included business scenarios have an executed result and evidence on accepted build; no Not Run or unresolved rule counted as accepted.
checks.Evidence needed: Per-scenario result register, coverage gap report and business decision; incomplete variants remain visible.

checks.Check: Blocking failures fixed/retested; any accepted residual risk is explicit and does not turn failed tests into passes.
checks.Evidence needed: Defect/retest references and signed/acknowledged risk acceptance with exact affected scope; business may decline acceptance.

checks.Check: Authorized business representative records accept, accept with named limitations, or reject.
checks.Evidence needed: Dated build-specific decision and reasons. QA/BA rehearsal alone is not customer acceptance.
